what: An annoyance row was added with its JSON in an unquoted shell heredoc: the backticks in its text ran as a command (a grep, read-only) and the row was refused as bad JSON. The same nesting rev-9 describes.
whys: the row's text was inside shell text
agents.py takes its row as one shell argument, so every row passes through a shell's quoting
there is no form of the command that reads the row from a file or stdin
class: text that passes through a shell on its way to a tool
prevention: agents.py reads its JSON from stdin or a file when given none as an argument; not built
workaround: build the JSON in Python under a quoted heredoc and pass it with subprocess
